# Fixture log for the CHUNKED nightly reporter — NOT a real sweep.
#
# Since 2026-09-06 the nightly fans out over a matrix (nightly_scope.py) and the
# report job concatenates every group's `sweep-<group>.txt` into one file. This
# fixture is that concatenation: two group headers, the `ok` rows that make a
# cartridge "covered", FAIL rows in both groups, and one per-group summary line
# each. Feed it with --scope .github/fixtures/nightly-multigroup-scope.txt to
# exercise the completeness check: the scope names five cartridges and only
# four appear here, so `fixture-never` must be reported as NEVER RENDERED.
#
# The slugs are deliberately fake (`fixture-*`): no cartridge in this repo is
# named that, so an issue raised from this file cannot be mistaken for a real
# failure.
=== nightly group g0 : fixture-alpha fixture-beta ===
cartridges: 2
  FAIL fixture-alpha: render (print, body, cadquery): FAIL — mesh is not watertight (2 open edges)
  ok fixture-beta (./fixture-beta)
y4d-spec check: cartridges=2 failures=1 rendered=6 presets=2
=== nightly group g1 : fixture-gamma fixture-delta ===
cartridges: 2
  FAIL fixture-gamma: render (display, lid, preset 'tall', openscad): FAIL — geometry is identical to the fallback body
  ok fixture-delta (./fixture-delta)
y4d-spec check: cartridges=2 failures=1 rendered=5 presets=1
